{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Nightingale floors squeak underfoot, so walk lightly and let the castle do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wooden facades and tea-house lanterns, best taken slowly with your phone in your pocket."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lanterns wake up here after dark, and the narrow alley does the rest."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done with quiet precision, a gentle splurge that still feels like Kyoto."}]}
